text: Delay penalties must be capped and must exclude delays caused by the client, scope changes or outside events.
Liability should be about 1x the fees and never unlimited; it should be proportionate to the contract value. (A preference, not a rule.)
Indemnity should be mutual. AtliQ does not cover the other side's own negligence.
Governing law: India for AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd, the US for AtliQ Inc. Exceptions are possible but should be deliberate.
The client owns what AtliQ builds for them; AtliQ keeps its own pre-existing tools.
On termination, AtliQ is paid for work done.
Confidentiality should be mutual. A contract titled mutual must be checked for what each side is actually bound to.
No clash with promises AtliQ has already made: non-competes, exclusivity, most-favoured pricing, IP handed over, data location.
